credit.credit-words: WORDS: Thomas O. Chisholm, 1917. MUSIC: “Lowden”; Carl H. Lowden, 1915; arr. by Hymnary.org. Public Domain.

Walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God. Col. 1:10 A living sacrifice. Rom. 12:1 I now live... by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me. Gal. 2:20
